chain.note: Both trees reach the main theorem by the paper's route: bank-exchange network, frames, nested labels with L < N/2, s_b < W_b m and s_c < W_c m, deficits above 20*2^-50 giving tau = sigma = 1-2^-50, rank-priced shears and the recurrences, O(V e^tau) interchange and O(V d^{lambda'}) layers, transform costs, the cost table and kappa. A nests this block under the ring convolution and supports L = Ich with the full residual table, but lacks the existence of orthonormal residual bases. B has a separate central node that feeds both procedures and carries L4 and the explicit phase formula, but omits the residual table. Neither chain breaks.

errors.says: The side-wire residual from time 0 to time 2, of dimension (a-1)(h-1)+1, is obtained using that the two triples are orthogonal.
errors.paper: That row follows directly by splitting A = B perp P and F = <t> perp t^perp; the neighbour relation t_X perp t_Y is used essentially only on the side edge 2->5.

errors.says: The recurrence solves to O(e^tau) for the bit network and O(e^lambda) for the complex one.
errors.paper: For the complex network the internal costs sum to O(e^lambda) but the leaves contribute O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)}), and the layer total is O(d^{lambda'}).

errors.says: Every nonzero residual over F_2 is nonalternating because it contains a coordinate unit vector of norm one.
errors.paper: The norm-one vector is built by tensoring chosen norm-one vectors (including the triple-indicator vectors spanning P and Q) and placing it in an orthogonal summand; it is not in general a coordinate unit.

errors.says: Run the first b+1 <= K rounds on prefix slots bit by bit, then the remaining qK rounds with the fast simultaneous layer.
errors.paper: First the round at h = l-1 on the long axes, then the qK rounds on the chunks, and finally the bottom positions h = b-1..0.

errors.says: The algorithm obtains the exact 2n-bit product in O(Tp) steps beyond the layer costs.
errors.paper: Besides the layer rows, the cost table has Gaussian line maps (d p^{1/2+delta} alpha), CRT and axis layouts (d^2(1+l^tau)) and packed products (log(rp)) per unit volume, all above O(1).

overall.reason: Neither plan has a major error, and both carry the whole central chain from the network's rank deficit to tau and kappa. In the label lemma A's residual table and B's orthonormal-basis step balance each other. In matrix-shear A alone states how the triangular factors are applied. Elsewhere B is consistently more complete: the per-invocation count and packed-call uniformity in the simultaneous layer, the explicit phase formula P1, the Gaussian maps defining A and B_0, the L-conjugated transform counterparts, the opposite-sign procedure by conjugation, disk margins, exceptional-stream cost, and the stream primitives. All these differences are at the level of completeness within derivations, and both plans have only minor errors, so the preference is slight.
